log.hypothesis: Flag channel 51 built from exact step units in the embed MLP plus pid rows, read by column 51 of every attention in_proj as a key penalty of >=30 logits; dropped neutrals become invisible except through kNN local features.
Baseline residual stream statistics for designing per-head flag directions; channel 51 should have modest variance.
Baseline residual statistics for later blocks and the body output read by the classifier.
Classifier block0 output gives the summary-token queries of classifier block1.
With block0 attention and MLP outputs zeroed, body.block0 equals the block-0 input (embedding sum), needed for block-0 query/key statistics.

Data-driven per-head flag directions (min-variance query direction with equal group means) and mean-ablation of channel 51 should remove most collateral damage while keeping dropped neutrals invisible.
Control: same flag channel and mean-ablation of channel 51 but no attention penalty; measures the cost of sacrificing channel 51 alone.
Channel 70 is ~45% cheaper to mean-ablate than 51 (data reader-cost), so the same circuit on f=70 should cut collateral error.
Same as v3a plus linear-regression restoration of channel 70 for every reader (R2 0.34-0.998), which should remove most of the sacrifice cost.
Control for v3b: regression restoration of channel 70 without the attention penalty; isolates sacrifice cost and its share of gen_drift.
Single-group min-variance direction, margin set from the 1e-4 query quantile and tau=0.15 median: smaller query offsets beta, so smaller bad term on kept keys.
Channel-70 flag with DyT weights set so the saturated kept value equals the channel mean (no column mean-ablation needed): far fewer DoF and the generator sees the mean instead of -w.
v4s plus regression restoration of channel 70 for all body and classifier readers.
Diagnostic: channel-70 regression edit with no penalty and no time-token saturation; if gen_drift falls well below 0.12 the time token caused most of the generator drift.
Full v4 regression construction on channel 51 instead of 70: channel 51 is little used by the generator, so gen_drift should be ~0.07 at a somewhat higher collateral error.
Channel-51 regression edit with guard against tiny saturated levels, no penalty: measures the sacrifice floor for channel 51.
Same with the L=30 penalty: rule probes should drop to the clean floor (~0.016).
Summary-token-weighted (x10) regression for channel-51 restoration: summary tokens carry the classification, so the collateral floor should fall below 0.017.
Same weighted regression on channel 70.
Classifier block1 output (summary tokens) is the input of classifier.fc; needed to restore channel-f readers in the classifier stream by regression.
Adds regression restoration of channel 51 for classifier MLP and classifier.fc readers (summary-token stream), the remaining unrestored readers; expect the clean floor to drop.
Channel 47 has lower body regression cost than 51 (0.34 vs 0.54) and moderate generator reader weight; expect floor between 70 and 51 with gen_drift < 0.1.
Channel 108: regression cost 0.48, generator reader cost like 51.
Small channel-51 edit: DyT weights set to the channel mean, penalty columns only, no regression; floor ~ mean-ablation of 51 (~0.03).
Mid: regression restoration only for attention readers (in_proj) and classifier, MLP readers mean-only.
Mid: regression restoration only for MLP readers (fc1), attention readers mean-only.
MLP pre-activations of blocks 0-3; inverting fc1 gives the exact norm2 output that the MLP reads, for exact regression of channel 51.
MLP pre-activations of blocks 4-7, same purpose.
MLP-reader regression of channel 51 fitted on the exact norm2 outputs (fc1-inverted captures) instead of a block in/out average; should lower the floor below 0.0178.
Same MLP-only exact regression on channel 70.
Small channel-51 edit with lean embedding (only one fc2 entry per near-dead step unit): same function as s51 with fewer DoF.
Mid: lean embedding + exact MLP-reader regression of channel 51 (same function as m51c).
Large: mid + regression restoration for attention and classifier readers of channel 51.
Channel-70 full regression with exact MLP inputs: lowest collateral, but channel 70 is heavily read by the generator.
P_reco MLP pre-activations (blocks 0-3) to refit the channel-51 MLP-reader regression on softer-fragmentation jets, where the collateral is largest.
P_reco MLP pre-activations (blocks 4-7), same purpose.
Mid channel-51 edit with MLP-reader regression fitted on clean + P_reco jets; should lower the P-probe error toward the clean floor.
Channel-70 full regression with the clean+P_reco MLP fit.
Original model on clean jets plus one soft neutral hadron (E<2.2 GeV): expect a flaw similar in size to soft photons (e ~0.2-0.3 relative to clean).
Mid channel-51 edit on the same jets: the pid-7 branch of the flag (E<2.2) should drop the hadron, so error falls to the collateral floor (~0.015).
Channel-70 edit on the same jets: expect ~0.013.
Mid edit on the same 1024 clean jets used for the NH probe, to measure the collateral floor with my own normalisation; expect ~0.015 if the NH probe excess is real.
Control for the NH excess: same positions with a dropped photon (pid 6, pT<0.8, E<1.8). If the error is again ~0.029 the excess is kinematic (kNN), not pid-7 specific.
